verdict.rationale: Rippling publishes a documented public v2 REST API at rest.ripplingapis.com. The docs cover Bearer API tokens for customer and internal automation, scoped permissions, dated version pinning, cursor pagination, OAuth 2.0 for partner apps and an official npm SDK, and a probe confirmed the developer docs are live. However, the evidence never shows IT-specific endpoints such as devices, app access or inventory, so it is unproven how much of the IT product can actually be driven through the API. Missing for 10: documented IT-specific endpoints (devices, identity/access, inventory), independent or hands-on corroboration of API use.
